areaGuide.title: Living in USJ Subang Jaya – Complete Guide to Room Rental in USJ
areaGuide.description: USJ (UEP Subang Jaya) is one of the most established residential areas in Selangor for room rental and property rental. The area attracts students, working professionals, families, medical staff, entrepreneurs and expatriates looking for affordable yet convenient accommodation near Subang Jaya, Sunway and Petaling Jaya. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in USJ, a single room near USJ Taipan, a fully furnished room close to USJ LRT, a studio apartment in Subang Jaya or a budget-friendly shared room, USJ offers a wide range of rental choices. Residents enjoy excellent transportation connectivity, shopping malls, universities, healthcare facilities, commercial centres and family-friendly neighbourhoods, making USJ one of the best places to rent a room in Selangor.
highlights: Large selection of master rooms, medium rooms, single rooms, studio rooms and shared rooms for rent in USJ
Close to USJ Taipan, Main Place Mall, Da Men Mall and Subang Jaya commercial areas
Excellent connectivity via USJ 7 LRT Station, Taipan LRT Station and Subang Jaya KTM Station
